title: /data page: the side drawer draws no "Open as full page" button, unlike the object list drawer
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oK4fFfnLADcipbEeT

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding owed by the L1 REWORK of PR #36283 (#35875, comment 7074529092). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

On the bare data page (`/data`), the side drawer (opened from the name cell's hover icon since PR #36283, or by `?recordId=`) draws no ⤢ 「Open as full page」 button. The object list's drawer (`ObjectView`) has one. This predates #36283; the dev noted it in that PR's Acceptance notes.

Read from code, not measured on a running page.

## To do

- Give the data page's drawer the same ⤢ 「Open as full page」 control the object list's drawer has, opening the full page with the same `from` origin as a name click.
- Pin it beside the data page's open-rule test.

## Acceptance

- On `/data`, open a record in the side drawer: the ⤢ button is there and opens the full page; ✕ on that page returns to `/data`.

Reader: area:ux (`domain:ui`), `ui/packages/app-shell`.

Dedupe: `data page drawer open as full page` (objectstack, open) → to be read by triage.
